comment: * Interface definition for a callback to be invoked when a drag start gesture is detected.

methods.name: boolean onDragStart(@NonNull View v, @NonNull DragStartHelper helper)
methods.comment:
* Called when a drag start gesture has been detected.
         *
         * @param v The view over which the drag start gesture has been detected.
         * @param helper The DragStartHelper object which detected the gesture.
         * @return True if the listener has started the drag operation, false otherwise.

methodNames: boolean onDragStart(@NonNull View v, @NonNull DragStartHelper helper)
